title: Murtuja v. U.P. Power Corporation Ltd.
court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
coram: Tarun Agarwala, J.; Saumitra Dayal Singh, J.
disposition: EE directed to decide pending Clause 6.5 bill-correction application
headnote: Writ disposed by directing the Executive Engineer, Electricity Distribution Division, Padrauna, to decide the petitioner's pending application for correction of the electricity bill under Clause 6.5 of the Electricity Supply Code, 2005 within four weeks of production of a certified copy. The Court did not examine the bill on merits.
facts: The petitioner, Murtuja, filed Writ-C No. 2990 of 2018 against U.P. Power Corporation Limited and two others before the Allahabad High Court. His application for correction of an electricity bill was pending consideration before the Executive Engineer, Electricity Distribution Division, Padrauna, impleaded as respondent no.3. He sought a direction for decision of that application. Counsel for the petitioner and for the Corporation were heard. The Court did not examine the correctness of the bill on merits.

holding_units.topic: pending bill-correction application before Executive Engineer
holding_units.holding: Where a consumer's application for correction of an electricity bill is pending before the Executive Engineer, the writ may be disposed of by directing that officer to decide the application under Clause 6.5 of the Electricity Supply Code, 2005 within a fixed time, without adjudicating the bill on merits.

not_decided.note: Left for decision by the Executive Engineer on the pending Clause 6.5 application.
